## Social Fetch - Facebook

Sub-workflow. Called by **Social Daily Report - Orchestrator**.

Input: `account_id` (Page ID), `channel`, `likes_label`, `days`

### Two credentials, routed by channel
Meta migrated both Pages to the "New Pages Experience", which rejects a User Access Token -- each Page needs its own **Page Access Token**. `Which account? (posts)` and `Which account? (insights)` both route by `channel` (exact match on "Brand A"):
- Brand A branch -> credential **Facebook Brand A account**
- Everything else (Brand B) -> credential **Facebook Brand B account**

Both the posts fetch AND the reel-insights fetch need this split -- a Page token only authorizes calls for its own Page, so a single shared credential can't serve both accounts' Reels either.

### What changed vs the old build
- Removed `Get page accounts` + `Get page token`. The Page token now lives in the credential, so we no longer call the accounts endpoint.
- `Get reel insights` has **Always Output Data** + **Continue on error** enabled, so one failing reel can no longer break the whole report.
- Insights are matched to their source post via `pairedItem` instead of array index, which removes the silent metric-misalignment bug.
- `Finalize output` flattens `pairedItem` after the multi-input `Merge rows` node, working around an n8n engine bug (n8n-io/n8n#35559) where an item routed through a Merge node's second input crashes the parent Execute Workflow node.
